role: P3-3 quality-gate band-setters + ppl slice. Binding gate record: DECISIONS.md 2026-08-25 'Phase 3 gates pre-committed' (veto-closed 2026-08-26); this file carries the measured numbers and the protocol.

protocol.concatenation: "".join(parquet text rows, stored order) — non-empty rows carry their trailing newline
protocol.tokenization: pinned HF tokenizer, add_special_tokens=False, first 4096 tokens
protocol.ppl: exp(mean NLL) over positions 1..4095, one causal window, float64 NLL over fp32 logits, KV-cached chunked prefill (chunk 512)
protocol.teacher_forcing: committed input_ids + committed reference argmax ids (identical prefixes, 250 steps)
protocol.agreement: argmax(engine fp32 logits, first-index tie-break) == committed reference argmax id
protocol.kl: KL(P_fp32 || P_engine) nats, float64 full-vocab softmax, mean over 250 steps
protocol.mlx_compute: as-shipped mlx-lm 4-bit (fp16 activations); logits cast fp32 before float64 statistics
protocol.hf_reference_verification: byte-identical committed checkpoint blobs at steps {0,1,24,49} x 5 prompts; argmax == steps.json at all 250 steps

ref_logits_artifact.note: local-only (152 MB >> fixture budget); sha256 also recorded in DECISIONS.md; Swift suite skips if absent

gates_reminder.note: constants are binding in DECISIONS.md, restated here for the reader only

ppl_slice_ref_nll.bin.note: diagnostic per-position fp32 NLL of the fp32 reference; ppl_fp32 in this file is the float64 scalar of record
